text:
alexa: Quick heads-up 10:00 sync flagged our launch timeline as at-risk. Two big blockers: tenant routing complexity and a cache-induced embedding accuracy regression. Need a concrete carve plan.
diego: FWIW tenants routing is bigger than we thought. It's backend auth + route isolation + billing changes. Minimal viable pilot doesn't need full tenant routing.
noah: Agree. Customer pilots (FirTree) only require SSO and per-tenant usage reporting, not full routing. We could implement a forward-proxy isolation later.
vivian: About caching: tests showed embedding distance drift for long-tail queries when using the new sharded cache. Risk of false negatives for similarity search. Ops also saw 1.2x token usage with the temp workaround.
alexa: Proposed carve: MVP = hosted API (single-tenant), SSO integration for pilot customers, per-tenant billing records exported to billing service, observability and basic rate-limits. Exclude tenant routing, on-prem, and the new embedding cache. Caching becomes a v1 opt-in after accuracy sign-off.
diego: That sounds reasonable. Add explicit launch acceptance criteria: (a) SSO flow end-to-end with ACME + FirTree, (b) billing export validated on 10k requests/day, (c) perf regression <10% on p95 for gen endpoints, (d) security review complete.
noah: Also need rollout plan: gated feature flag per-tenant, kill-switch, and fallback to small-model serving. Example rollback setting: FEATURE_SSOPILOT=false and default_model=redwood-micro.
vivian: Action items: Eng to produce a one-page risk table and a cutlist with rough engineering-weeks. Data to include worst-case cost delta if caching is disabled.
alexa: Product to own stakeholder comms and a short customer appendix that defines "pilot readiness" and support expectations.
diego: Decision rule: If embedding accuracy fix not validated in staging by Thu COB, we ship without cache and add a 2-week post-launch iteration to enable it. If fix validated, we include opt-in caching but disable it by default.
pm-bot: New ticket created: https://redwood.internal/tickets/1779990011-pilot-cutlist  assigned to diego.
alexa: I'll update the public roadmap slice and send an executive summary. Re-check Monday AM.
